data.name: ConsoleHelp
data.value:
Lilo: ftps-server [options] ftps-server --config <path-to-json>
Awọn aṣayan:
--help Fi iranlọwọ yii han.
--config <path> Faili iṣeto JSON.
--ip <address> Adirẹsi IP ti yoo gbọ. Aiyipada: 0.0.0.0. 0.0.0.0, :: ati ::0 n gbọ lori gbogbo wiwo IPv4 ati IPv6.
--port <number> Pootu ti yoo gbọ. Aiyipada: 2121. A gba: 2121-65535.
--maxconnections <number> Iye idapọ ti o pọ julọ ni akoko kan. Aiyipada: 10. A gba: 2-100.
--cert <path> Faili iwe-ẹri (.pfx, .pem tabi .der). Faili .pfx yoo ṣi pẹlu --certpass ti ọrọ igbaniwọle ba wa.
--certpass <password> Ọrọ igbaniwọle faili iwe-ẹri.
--certstorename <name> Orukọ ile ipamọ: AuthRoot, CertificateAuthority, My, Root tabi TrustedPublisher. Fi pọ pẹlu --certstorelocation ati --certstoresubject.
--certstorelocation <location> Ibi ile ipamọ: CurrentUser tabi LocalMachine. Fi pọ pẹlu --certstorename ati --certstoresubject.
--certstoresubject <subject> Orukọ koko lati wa ninu ile ipamọ iwe-ẹri. Fi pọ pẹlu --certstorename ati --certstorelocation.
--user <login#password#folder#permissions> N fi olumulo kun. Aṣẹ: R (kika), W (kikọ) tabi RW. Folda gbọdọ ti wa tẹlẹ. Ma lo # ninu awọn aaye mẹrin.
Awọn apẹẹrẹ: ftps-server --config settings.json ftps-server --ip 0.0.0.0 --port 2121 --user "admin#secret#C:\ftp\admin#RW" ftps-server --cert server.pfx --certpass secret
Laisi awọn ariyanjiyan, appsettings.json ninu folda lọwọlọwọ yoo kó wọle ti faili ba wa. Ti olumulo ko ba ṣeto, iṣeto ibaraenisepo yoo bẹrẹ.
